import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

def make(tag):
    smi = ("CC1=C(C)C(C)=C(C)[C-]1[Ir+]"
           "2([N-](/C(C)=N/c3c(C)cccc3C)"
           "[C"+tag+"H](c4cccc[n+]42)C(O)(c5ccccc5)C(F)(F)F)")
    return Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)

# target signed volume for neighbor order (N_amide, C_py2, C_quat, H) at stereocenter:
# from drawing: N up in-plane, pyC left in-plane, H hash(back,-z), Cq wedge(front,+z)
a=np.array([0,1,0.]); b=np.array([-0.9,-0.3,0.]); c=np.array([0.3,-0.8,0.8]); d=np.array([0.9,0.1,-0.7])
target = np.dot(b-a, np.cross(c-a, d-a))
print("target sign:", np.sign(target))

for tag in ["@@","@"]:
    m = make(tag)
    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, randomSeed=42)
    conf = mh.GetConformer()
    # find stereocenter: carbon with H, bonded to N(amide), aromatic py C, C(O) quat
    for at in mh.GetAtoms():
        if at.GetSymbol()=="C" and at.GetTotalNumHs()==1:
            nbrs = [n.GetSymbol() for n in at.GetNeighbors()]
            if nbrs.count("C")==2 and nbrs.count("N")==1:
                # identify neighbors
                Nn = [n for n in at.GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=="N"][0]
                Cs = [n for n in at.GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=="C"]
                # py C is aromatic in ring with n+; quat C has F neighbors
                py = [n for n in Cs if n.GetIsAromatic()][0]
                cq = [n for n in Cs if not n.GetIsAromatic()][0]
                H = [n for n in at.GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=="H"][0]
                pts = [np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(x.GetIdx())) for x in (Nn,py,cq,H)]
                v = np.dot(pts[1]-pts[0], np.cross(pts[2]-pts[0], pts[3]-pts[0]))
                print(tag, "signed vol:", v, "match:", np.sign(v)==np.sign(target))
